## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with a pointed, pale face, freckles, and a thin body. Her hair is red—often described as auburn or splendid [Titian](../character/titian.md)—and has been worn in long braids as well as a glossy, tumbled style. She possesses prominent gray eyes, which have been described as solemn, serious, shining, luminous, and as alluring as evening stars, along with seven freckles on her nose.

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, smart, and quick-learning individual who can also be heedless and impulsive at times. Deeply fond of children, she is also a passionate [Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative) out of loyalty to Matthew's memory. Driven by a desire to add beauty to life, her motivations include passing her examinations high for [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and Marilla's sake and striving to win the Avery scholarship through hard work. She possesses a talent for reciting and has demonstrated skill in writing stories, notably winning a twenty-five-dollar competition prize for her work.

## History

Orphaned as an infant and raised outside Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) during a lonely, starved childhood, Anne was adopted out of an orphan asylum by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though initially met with skepticism due to her intense imagination and fierce temper, Anne quickly proved her worth by apologizing for a outburst against Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), helping around the farm, and saving the life of [Diana](../character/diana.md) Barry's baby sister. She excelled academically, forming an intense rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), starting a story club, and eventually tying for first place on the Island's Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. After earning the Avery scholarship at Queen's and enduring the devastating death of her beloved [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) from a sudden heart attack, Anne chose to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to support [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). While working as a local schoolteacher and helping found the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), she inadvertently took in the mischievous orphaned twins [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith. Anne later pursued higher education at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), securing her financial future thanks to a thousand-dollar bequest from the late Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) and finally reading a collection of her deceased parents' love letters in her birthplace of [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Throughout her young adulthood, Anne navigated several clumsy marriage proposals—including ones from [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) on behalf of her brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), and her long-time suitor Royal Gardner—while mistakenly believing [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was engaged to someone else. Upon learning that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was near death from typhoid fever, Anne finally recognized her deep romantic feelings for him. Following his miraculous recovery, Anne accepted Gilbert's proposal in [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden, happily agreeing to marry him.

## Quotes

> "Well, that is another hope gone. ‘My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.’ That’s a sentence I read in a book once, and I say it over to comfort myself whenever I’m disappointed in anything."
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)

> “Oh, what I know about myself isn’t really worth telling,” said Anne eagerly. “If you’ll only let me tell you what I imagine about myself you’ll think it ever so much more interesting.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009)

> “I was afraid it might be Mrs. Spencer’s place,” said Anne mournfully. “I don’t want to get there. Somehow, it will seem like the end of everything.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P26](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0026)

> “I—I saw it this afternoon when you were away at the Aid Society,” said Anne, a little slowly. “I was passing your door when I saw it on the cushion, so I went in to look at it.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002)

> “I did put it back,” said Anne quickly—pertly, Marilla thought. “I don’t just remember whether I stuck it on the pincushion or laid it in the china tray. But I’m perfectly certain I put it back.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

Anne and Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) are kindred spirits who form a warm bond following the minister's arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Anne admires her greatly, beautifully decorating the tea table for her visit and later turning to her for comfort after mistakenly flavoring a layer cake with liniment. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) treats Anne with unfailing kindness, encouraging her through tears and providing compassionate support during times of grief.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>

### [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--bertha-shirley.md)

[Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) is Anne's deceased biological mother. Anne spent her early childhood carrying the painful loss of both her parents, but felt a deep, personal connection to her mother after visiting her birthplace in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) and reading her old love letters.

- Child of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne's relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) begins with intense enmity after he calls her "Carrots," prompting her to smash a slate over his head and hold a years-long academic rivalry. Over time, their hostility cools into a close, supportive friendship as fellow students and [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) comrades. Although [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) harbors romantic feelings for her, Anne insists on keeping him strictly in her friend circle, though she faces quiet jealousy and grief at the thought of losing him.

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Anne's strict yet deeply loving adoptive mother. Initially hesitant to keep the imaginative orphan and demanding discipline in household tasks and prayers, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gradually softens into a mother figure who fiercely supports and comforts Anne. In turn, Anne shows total devotion to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), altering her career and college plans to stay by her side when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) faces failing health.
